chunks.head: make a good showing
chunks.gloss: 表现出色；给人留下好印象
chunks.note: showing 此处指(公开场合下的)表现；make a good showing = 表现得体、有面子。

literal.note_cn: 此处指公开的表现，非“展示物”

chunks.ex_en: Our team wanted to make a good showing at the science fair.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们队想在科学展上表现出色。

chunks.head: come to the surface
chunks.note: 字面“浮到表面”，喻指原本隐藏的情绪、真相等暴露出来。
chunks.ex_en: His jealousy slowly came to the surface.
chunks.ex_cn: 他的嫉妒渐渐显露了出来。

chunks.head: hit upon
chunks.note: hit upon/on sth = 灵机一动想到(主意、办法)。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“打”，指偶然遇到、想到

chunks.ex_en: She hit upon a clever way to save money.
chunks.ex_cn: 她想到了一个省钱的妙招。

chunks.head: interfere with
chunks.note: interfere with sth = 干扰、妨碍某事的正常进行。
chunks.ex_en: Loud music interferes with my studying.
chunks.ex_cn: 吵闹的音乐干扰我学习。

chunks.head: take part in
chunks.note: take part in = 参加(活动、比赛等)，强调亲身参与。
chunks.ex_en: Every student can take part in the singing contest.
chunks.ex_cn: 每个学生都可以参加歌唱比赛。

chunks.head: out of order
chunks.note: 指机器、设备坏了不能用。本章把男孩的动作比作“有点失灵的机器”。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“正常运转”，非“命令/顺序”

chunks.ex_en: The lift is out of order, so we took the stairs.
chunks.ex_cn: 电梯坏了，我们走了楼梯。

chunks.head: get through
chunks.note: 本章指顺利做完(表演)。也可指通过考试、熬过难关等。
chunks.ex_en: I was nervous, but I got through my speech.
chunks.ex_cn: 我很紧张，但还是把演讲讲完了。

chunks.head: a round of applause
chunks.note: a round of applause = 一阵(集体的)掌声，常用于表演、发言之后。
chunks.ex_en: The audience gave her a big round of applause.
chunks.ex_cn: 观众给了她热烈的掌声。

chunks.head: break down
chunks.gloss: (说话/情绪)中断、垮掉；(机器)出故障
chunks.note: 本章指汤姆背演讲时中途卡壳、说不下去。也常指机器抛锚或人情绪崩溃。
chunks.ex_en: He broke down and forgot all his lines on stage.
chunks.ex_cn: 他一下卡住，在台上忘了所有台词。

chunks.head: clear one's throat
chunks.note: 说话或朗读前轻咳一声清嗓；也用于示意或缓解紧张。
chunks.ex_en: He cleared his throat before he began to sing.
chunks.ex_cn: 他唱歌前先清了清嗓子。

chunks.head: no matter what
chunks.note: no matter what (+从句) = 无论…都，引导让步状语。
chunks.ex_en: No matter what happens, I will support you.
chunks.ex_cn: 无论发生什么，我都支持你。

chunks.head: feel obliged to
chunks.note: feel obliged to do = 感到有责任、义务去做，常出于礼节或压力。
chunks.ex_en: She felt obliged to thank everyone who helped.
chunks.ex_cn: 她觉得应该感谢每个帮过忙的人。

chunks.head: from time to time
chunks.note: 表示不定期地、偶尔发生。

literal.note_cn: 习语固定用法，无独立含义

chunks.ex_en: We still meet up from time to time.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们还是会时不时聚一聚。

chunks.head: by far
chunks.note: 用于比较级/最高级前加强语气，表示差距很大。
chunks.ex_en: This is by far the best cake I've ever eaten.
chunks.ex_cn: 这是我吃过的最好吃的蛋糕，好太多了。

chunks.head: turn one's back to
chunks.note: turn one's back to/on = 把背转向某人/某物；引申可指“不理睬、背弃”。本章为字面义。
chunks.ex_en: He turned his back to the wind to light the match.

chunks.head: keep someone from doing
chunks.note: keep sb/sth from doing = 防止、使…不做某事。from 后接动名词。
chunks.ex_en: A fence keeps the dog from running away.

chunks.head: in an instant
chunks.note: instant = 瞬间；in an instant = 转眼之间、马上。
chunks.ex_en: The magician vanished in an instant.

chunks.head: break up
chunks.note: 本章指(会场)散场。也指分手、(团体)解散、(关系)破裂。
chunks.ex_en: The meeting broke up at noon.
